svg.title: Agent schema diagram
svg.desc: Agent templates embed nodes, edges and triggers; each edge wires one node to another by id, and each trigger references one of the template's nodes; a template with rag_enabled names its rag in rag_id. Each node is an instance of a node type (which supplies default config) and can point to a project credential. Templates and node types belong to the platform or to one project; credentials and agents belong to a project, and each agent runs one template. projects is drawn twice to keep lines from crossing.
